title: From Binary to Bilingual: How the National Weather Service is Using Artificial Intelligence to Develop a Comprehensive Translation Program

bias_targets.methodology: Cross-cultural terminology research (term harvesting), human-in-the-loop quality control by bilingual staff from diverse heritages, and linguistic scoring metrics (BLEU, COMET, back-translation) to ensure translations are dialect-neutral and semantically accurate across different language groups.

Engaging certified translators to select unbiased, culturally resonant terminology from authoritative glossaries, and collecting public feedback via rating systems and surveys to ensure translations are culturally representative.
